<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/142.0.0.0" version="29.2.6"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="zIn9ItICmZZPWIAeh_FE"> <mxGraphModel dx="2722" dy="1031" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <object label="" id="0"> <mxCell /> </object> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml Transaction_Deposit_Enhanced

!theme plain
skinparam backgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam roundcorner 5
skinparam shadowing false

skinparam participant {
 BackgroundColor #E8F4FD
 BorderColor #2196F3
 FontColor #1565C0
 FontSize 11
 FontStyle bold
}

skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor #E1F5FE
 BorderColor #0277BD
 FontColor #01579B
}

skinparam note {
 BackgroundColor #FFFDE7
 BorderColor #FF8F00
 FontColor #E65100
 FontSize 10
}

skinparam sequence {
 ArrowColor #1976D2
 ArrowFontColor #1565C0
 ArrowFontSize 10
 LifeLineBackgroundColor #FAFAFA
 LifeLineBorderColor #1976D2
 ParticipantBorderThickness 2
 BoxBorderColor #1976D2
}

skinparam title {
 FontColor #1565C0
 FontSize 16
 FontStyle bold
}

title **WillBank - Microservice Architecture**\n**Diagramme de Séquence: Dépôt sur Compte Bancaire**

box \"Client Layer\" #E8F5E8
 participant \"Client Application\" as Client
end box

box \"Gateway Layer\" #FFF3E0
 participant \"API Gateway\" as Gateway
end box

box \"Business Services\" #E3F2FD
 participant \"Transaction Service\" as TxnSvc
 participant \"Account Service\" as AccountSvc
end box

box \"Data Layer\" #F3E5F5
 participant \"Transaction DB\" as TxnDB
 participant \"Account DB\" as AccountDB
end box

box \"Integration Layer\" #FFEBEE
 participant \"RabbitMQ Broker\" as MQ
 participant \"Notification Service\" as NotifSvc
end box

note over Client, NotifSvc #FFFDE7
 **Cas d'usage:** Dépôt d'espèces sur compte bancaire
 **Montant:** 5000 XOF
 **Compte:** WB987654321
end note

Client -> Gateway: POST /api/transactions/deposit\n{accountNumber: \"WB987654321\", amount: 5000, description: \"Dépôt espèces\"}
activate Gateway

Gateway -> TxnSvc: DepositRequest
activate TxnSvc

note over TxnSvc: Validation du compte cible
TxnSvc -> AccountSvc: GET /api/accounts/WB987654321/balance
activate AccountSvc
AccountSvc -> AccountDB: SELECT * FROM accounts\nWHERE account_number = 'WB987654321'\nAND status = 'ACTIVE'
activate AccountDB
AccountDB --> AccountSvc: Account {balance: 15000, status: \"ACTIVE\"}
deactivate AccountDB
AccountSvc --> TxnSvc: Compte valide, solde actuel: 15000 XOF
deactivate AccountSvc

note over TxnSvc: Création de la transaction de dépôt
TxnSvc -> TxnSvc: generateTransactionReference()\n→ \"TXN-DEP456\"

TxnSvc -> TxnDB: INSERT Transaction\n{reference: \"TXN-DEP456\", type: \"DEPOSIT\",\nfromAccount: \"WB987654321\", amount: 5000,\ndescription: \"Dépôt espèces\", status: \"PENDING\"}
activate TxnDB
TxnDB --> TxnSvc: Transaction créée avec référence
deactivate TxnDB

note over TxnSvc: Mise à jour du solde du compte
TxnSvc -> AccountSvc: PUT /api/accounts/WB987654321/balance\n{amount: 5000, operation: \"CREDIT\"}
activate AccountSvc
AccountSvc -> AccountSvc: Validation: newBalance = 15000 + 5000 = 20000
AccountSvc -> AccountDB: UPDATE accounts\nSET balance = 20000, updated_at = NOW()\nWHERE account_number = 'WB987654321'
activate AccountDB
AccountDB --> AccountSvc: Solde mis à jour vers 20000 XOF
deactivate AccountDB
AccountSvc --> TxnSvc: Mise à jour confirmée, nouveau solde: 20000
deactivate AccountSvc

note over TxnSvc: Finalisation de la transaction
TxnSvc -> TxnDB: UPDATE Transaction\nSET status = 'COMPLETED', processedAt = NOW()\nWHERE reference = 'TXN-DEP456'
activate TxnDB
TxnDB --> TxnSvc: Transaction complétée
deactivate TxnDB

note over TxnSvc: Notification asynchrone
TxnSvc -> MQ: Publish TransactionCompletedEvent\n{reference: \"TXN-DEP456\", type: \"DEPOSIT\",\namount: 5000, account: \"WB987654321\"}
activate MQ
MQ -> NotifSvc: Process deposit notification
activate NotifSvc
NotifSvc -> NotifSvc: Envoyer SMS + Push notification\n\"Dépôt de 5000 XOF effectué.\nNouveau solde: 20000 XOF\"
NotifSvc --> MQ: Notification envoyée
deactivate NotifSvc
MQ --> TxnSvc: Event traité
deactivate MQ

TxnSvc --> Gateway: TransactionDto {reference: \"TXN-DEP456\",\nstatus: \"COMPLETED\", newBalance: 20000}
Gateway --> Client: 201 Created - Dépôt effectué avec succès

deactivate TxnSvc
deactivate Gateway

note over Client, NotifSvc: Résultat: Dépôt de 5000 XOF effectué\nSolde du compte WB987654321: 15000 → 20000 XOF

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="_8GVFEKXpBxwY56eQR2o-11"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1197" width="1793" x="-580" y="330" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
